mentions.name: Tuppence
mentions.description: Tuppence is an online payment platform ('payment rails') for businesses, developers and agents. It lets users accept online card payments from 0.79% (UK), get paid out to their bank, and earn 0.89% back on all card spend with no cashback caps or limits, with no SaaS fees or contract lock-in. Selling tools include a store builder, expense management, payment links, direct debits and bookings, positioned as a business layer on top of processors like Stripe, Adyen and Checkout.com, plus a 'connect' platform for marketplace businesses. A Point of Sale device manufactured in the UK with card readers supports in-person payments. Roadmap includes ticketing and a 'treasury' feature with 4% yield on earnings, FDIC/FSCS insurance, multi-currency fiat balances (USD, EUR, GBP) and stablecoin balances (OUSD, USDC), and bank account numbers for sending and receiving funds. Early adopters can receive fee-free payment processing.
mentions.problem: People selling their goods pay over the odds to payment processors; Tuppence aims to help them make a living without excessive payment fees.
